ISO 45001

What is ISO 45001?

Achieving ISO 45001 demonstrates that your business takes a strong stance towards its occupational health and safety practices and is pulling out all the stops to keep its staff, customers and stakeholders free from harm.

As the best-regarded international standard for health and safety management systems, it's designed to prevent work-related injuries, illnesses, and accidents while promoting a safe, positive working environment for everyone.

Why invest in ISO 45001?

ISO 45001 certification will help you:

Comply with health and safety legislation

The UK has some of the most stringent health and safety regulations in the world, particularly those under the Health and Safety at Work Act 1974. ISO 45001 provides a comprehensive framework that will help you meet your legal obligations and avoid fines and other disruptive legal actions.

Reduce workplace injuries and illnesses

One of the primary objectives of ISO 45001 is to reduce workplace accidents, injuries, and illnesses — by implementing effective policies, identifying potential hazards, and putting controls in place to mitigate risks.

Reduce costs associated with incidents

Direct costs may include medical expenses, compensation claims, and fines, while indirect costs can involve lost productivity, increased insurance premiums, and reputational damage. ISO 45001 helps you proactively manage these.

Gain a reputation for being responsible

Certification demonstrates that you are committed to running a safe working environment, so your customers, employees and stakeholders feel they are in the best hands. It also helps attract and retain staff.

Adopt a systematic approach to risk

Better systems reduce disruption caused by accidents or health-related issues. In a high-risk sector such as construction or manufacturing, managing risk robustly quickly becomes a competitive advantage.

Mitigate legal risk

Under ISO 45001 you conduct risk assessments, implement preventive measures, and regularly review and improve your safety procedures — demonstrating due diligence and compliance with best practice.

Stay accountable

ISO 45001 promotes a cycle of continual improvement which keeps you on top of your health and safety performance, so you can adapt quickly when regulations evolve.

Improve in-house safety initiatives

The standard asks that you promote a culture of safety throughout the organisation, engaging employees at all levels and ensuring everyone understands their responsibilities.

Access more opportunities

If you've got one eye on growth, ISO 45001 certification helps you meet global health and safety expectations wherever your business activities are taking place.
